qualification: No original production source edited; loader validates exact original Git bytes and returns those unchanged bytes with the loader Bun selected; no source rewrite.
Only one authority history graph is captured; no old execution/claim/write graph or uncaptured original HTTP whitespace claim.
Local explicit fixed1000 clock and10000 lease are independent of current credential time.
Actual original receipt value serialization is explicitly pinned, not claimed captured original HTTP response whitespace.

limits: Runtime observer validates152 original TypeScript modules and passes their bytes unchanged to Bun selected TS loader; third-party JavaScript remains native, pinned installed package/lock/Bun environment is shared.

Attempt1 documented undefined loader return failed at runtime; attempt2 interception of third-party CommonJS failed export setup; attempt3 succeeded APIs but overstrict postcapture SHM helper assertion failed. All three are unqualified.
Immutable physical observation occurs only after original close and independent absent-WAL/SHM/journal observation; it establishes no writer exclusion or concurrent backup policy.
